risks.note: International operations are influenced by global economic conditions, geopolitical tensions, trade restrictions, sanctions and armed conflicts, which may disrupt supply chains, alter trade routes, increase transportation costs and affect cargo volumes.

The Company operates in a highly regulated environment covering customs, taxation, transportation, trade, environmental standards, data protection and corporate governance; changes in requirements or non-compliance may result in penalties, higher compliance costs and reputational impact.

Increasing adoption of digital platforms and automated processes has increased exposure to cybersecurity threats, ransomware attacks, data breaches and system failures, which may affect operations, customer confidence and regulatory compliance.

Exposure to foreign exchange fluctuations, credit risk, liquidity constraints, interest rate movements and delayed customer payments requires effective financial management to mitigate adverse impacts on cash flows and profitability.

risks.note: The logistics sector faces challenges in talent acquisition, employee retention, workforce productivity and availability of skilled personnel; failure to attract and retain qualified professionals may impact operational efficiency and service quality.

risks.title: Risks (RHP)
risks.body:
- Operations depend on the efficient functioning of transportation networks, ports, airports, customs processes, warehousing facilities and third-party service providers; port congestion, vessel schedule disruptions, transportation bottlenecks, infrastructure constraints, labour shortages and natural disasters may adversely affect service delivery, transit timelines and operating costs.
- The logistics industry remains susceptible to fluctuations in freight rates, fuel prices, transportation costs and carrier capacity, which may impact profitability, pricing strategies and customer demand patterns.
- International operations are influenced by global economic conditions, geopolitical tensions, trade restrictions, sanctions and armed conflicts, which may disrupt supply chains, alter trade routes, increase transportation costs and affect cargo volumes.
- The Company operates in a highly regulated environment covering customs, taxation, transportation, trade, environmental standards, data protection and corporate governance; changes in requirements or non-compliance may result in penalties, higher compliance costs and reputational impact.
- Increasing adoption of digital platforms and automated processes has increased exposure to cybersecurity threats, ransomware attacks, data breaches and system failures, which may affect operations, customer confidence and regulatory compliance.
- Exposure to foreign exchange fluctuations, credit risk, liquidity constraints, interest rate movements and delayed customer payments requires effective financial management to mitigate adverse impacts on cash flows and profitability.
- The logistics sector faces challenges in talent acquisition, employee retention, workforce productivity and availability of skilled personnel; failure to attract and retain qualified professionals may impact operational efficiency and service quality.
- The logistics industry is highly competitive, with large integrated logistics companies, global freight forwarders, regional operators and unorganized participants; intense competition may lead to pricing pressure, margin compression and challenges in customer acquisition and retention.

strategy.title: Strategies (RHP)
strategy.body:
- Strengthen operational capabilities and service quality across the integrated logistics platform.
- Expand business relationships and customer base while embracing digital transformation.
- Pursue sustainable, profitable growth while remaining responsive to evolving customer needs.
- Strengthen domestic and international operations and expand service capabilities.
- Focus on process automation, digital documentation, shipment tracking and information management to improve efficiency and transparency.
